messages:
Maya: Heads up — since the 02:13 canary deploy, a subset of inference pods in eu-west1 can't pull model shards from our S3 mirror, getting 502/503 from the egress gateway.
Alex: saw it, logs show envoy: 'tls handshake failed: SNI mismatch' for s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com
Maya: weird — we didn't touch S3 rules. Any egress policy changed?
Priya: I rolled out an Istio AuthorizationPolicy update at 02:00 to tighten egress to only allowed domains (A/B test). Could be that.
Javier: quick check: kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference -o wide -> many pods on node-gpu-19, all have sidecar injected.
deploy-bot: canary deploy auth-policy-v2 at 02:00 (20% traffic)
Alex: reproducing locally — curl https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/healthcheck -> 503 via egress-gateway
Maya: can someone tcpdump on node-gpu-19? sudo tcpdump -i any host s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com
Priya: grabbing istio-proxy logs: envoy => 'RDS: route not found for authority: s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com'
Javier: found policy: AuthorizationPolicy egress-allow-domains matches header ':authority' exact 's3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' — oops hardcoded region
Alex: that explains SNI mismatch — egress gateway rewrites TLS SNI to allowed host and target rejects TLS/HOST check
Maya: temporary mitigation: update AuthorizationPolicy to include wildcard for s3.*.amazonaws.com and restart egress-gateway in eu-west1
Priya: pushed quick fix: kubectl apply -f egress-policy-wildcard.yaml
ops-bot: rollout-status egress-gateway eu-west1 -> succeeded
Maya: verified model pulls resumed; canary and remaining pods now fetch shards from mirror successfully
Javier: action item: add integration test for egress policy SNI handling + add automated alert for spikes in 5xx to external mirrors
Alex: also add note in runbook: when tightening egress policies double-check region-specific hostnames and SNI behavior for TLS passthrough
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya: filing a short postmortem/why-runbook: https://wiki/redwood/infrastructure/pm-1812345678
Maya: closing thread — reopen if recurrence
